title: YouTube nears $3 billion settlement with US school districts over addiction claims: Bloomberg News
summary: The deal also includes product safeguards for teens and is contingent on a majority of districts signing on, with finalization likely to take a few months, the report said, citing people familiar with the matter. Any settlement would have to be approved by US District Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers in Oakland, California, who is overseeing the litigation.
llm_summary: YouTube is close to a roughly $3 billion settlement with dozens of U.S. school districts that allege the platform fuels teen addiction. The deal, which still needs approval from Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers, would also require YouTube to add new safety features for younger users and will only go forward once a majority of the districts sign on.
